ResearchProjectDef.label: greenhouse glazing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reinforced glass panels that can be fitted into a roof, plus the automated hatch mechanism used to bleed off excess heat. Lets an enclosed room trap the warmth of the day instead of tracking the outdoor temperature.

ResearchProjectDef.label: field logistics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Light crates that can be dragged out to the edge of a field so harvesters have somewhere to drop produce, instead of leaving it scattered across the soil to rot.
